description: Western Sahara Transportation Network (5 data sets, OCHA Middle East and North Africa, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA). Morocco transportation network shows layers of airports; classification layers for roads; Railways; and ports. Data source WFP 2011. Coverage: Algeria, Western Sahara, Libya, Morocco, Tunisia. The portal lists 5 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA). Its tags are aviation, geodata, ports, railways, roads. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
